title: Arrangement Count Suffix
brief: A scheduling tool reports how many ways n distinct jobs can be ordered, which is the product 1 times 2 times ... times n. The number is huge, so the report shows it in a compact form and needs to know how many zero digits it ends with.
Implement countEndingZeros(n), where n is the number of jobs, and return how many consecutive zeros appear at the end of that product written in decimal.
